candidateDecisions.name: task_templates table and Task Template CRUD response/API surface
candidateDecisions.action: Keep task_templates, its repository/service/type, and all five CRUD/list routes. Do not add a DROP TABLE migration.

candidateDecisions.name: shopping_templates table and Shopping Template CRUD/add routes
candidateDecisions.action: Keep the table and list route as canonical; retain CRUD/detail/add routes as compatibility APIs and cover list + reuse in contract tests.

candidateDecisions.name: dashboard legacy response fields
candidateDecisions.action: Keep todayTasks, weeklyTasks, and summary in the Worker response and TypeScript contract; no response-field migration.

candidateDecisions.name: calendar additive count/status compatibility fields
candidateDecisions.action: Keep fixedCompletedCount, fixedSkippedCount, shoppingCount, purchasedShoppingCount, status, and related Calendar fields; protect with current-response contract tests.

candidateDecisions.name: legacy task recurrence columns / enum values
candidateDecisions.action: Keep legacy recurrence columns, enum values, weekdays, monthly fields, and fallback/normalization paths; do not rewrite existing task rows.

candidateDecisions.name: nullable task-record snapshots / calendar_action_date
candidateDecisions.action: Keep nullable columns and fallback readers; do not add NOT NULL, rewrite, or historical data migration.
